defaultPrompt: Help me decide and build the next product slice with GrillTrack.
Use Cursor ACP to delegate one bounded implementation slice to local Grok 4.6.
Use Antigravity ACP to diagnose official Google Antigravity setup or delegate one bounded slice. Plugin default is exact advertised gemini-3.8-flash-high.
Use Grok ACP to delegate one bounded implementation slice to local grok agent stdio. Plugin default is exact advertised grok-4.7.
